## README.md
# Field boundaries for Spain Castilla y León

Provides 10232880 official field boundaries from Spain Castilla y León.
It has been converted to a fiboa GeoParquet file from data obtained from Spain Castilla y León.

- **Source Data Provider:** [Spain Castilla y León](https://www.itacyl.es/)
- **Converted by:** Ivor Bosloper
- **License:** CC-NC (a Non-free license)
- **Projection:** EPSG:4258

---

- [Download the data as fiboa GeoParquet](https://data.source.coop/fiboa/es-cl/es_cl.parquet)
- [STAC Browser](https://radiantearth.github.io/stac-browser/#/external/data.source.coop/fiboa/es-cl/stac/collection.json)
- [STAC Collection](https://data.source.coop/fiboa/es-cl/stac/collection.json)
- [PMTiles](https://data.source.coop/fiboa/es-cl/es_cl.pmtiles)

## Columns

| Property               | **Data Type** | Description |
|------------------------|---------------|-------------|
| id                     | string        |             |
| determination_datetime | timestamp     |             |
| crop:code              | string        |             |
| crop:name              | string        |             |
| crop:name_en           | string        |             |
| crop:code_list         | string        |             |

## Lineage

- Data downloaded on 2024-12-24 from manually downloaded file .
- Converted to GeoParquet using [fiboa-cli](https://github.com/fiboa/cli), version 0.8.0
